response_item.revised_prompt: Create a production MATERIAL TEXTURE SOURCE, not an illustration of an object: one square image filled edge to edge entirely with weathered charcoal-black painted cast iron, as a hand-painted texture for a tiny isometric painterly game street surveillance pole. No scene, no pole, no object silhouettes, no text, no borders, no perspective, no dramatic light, no added shadow, no transparency needed. Orthographic flat material field. Desaturated near-neutral charcoal grey (absolutely no green tint). Uneven old iron casting with very subtle broad tonal irregularity, tiny hand-painted scratches and rubbed edges distributed sparsely, some warm grey rubbed exposed metal specks. Restrained contrast, mostly dark charcoal grey with occasional mid-grey chips. Brush-painted, not photographic, not vector or cel shaded, not random pixel static. Material needs readable irregular worn patina at small game scale. Avoid deep black cracks, masonry patterns, obvious directional seams, rusty orange, glossy shine. Produce 1024 by 1024 square raw material texture suitable for independently mapping onto multiple editable source surfaces.
